basics.name: Dave Beach
basics.heroText2: A freelance developer that gets shit done
basics.summary: I’m a senior full-stack developer with over 17 years of experience building everything from satellite imaging platforms to digital ecosystems for global brands. I combine technical precision with big-picture thinking to help mission-driven teams bring meaningful ideas to life. Whether you need a creative collaborator to launch a fast, resilient web app or a lead engineer to guide your team through complex challenges, I bring clarity, care, and the mindset of a grounded idealist with a bias for action.
